meta.name: translate
meta.description: Translate English or Japanese tech articles and texts into natural, fluent Chinese. Use this skill when the user wants to translate text to Chinese, asks for Chinese translation, mentions "translate to Chinese", "翻译", provides English/Japanese tech content for translation, or wants any text converted into Chinese. Also trigger when the user pastes text and asks to translate it, or references a file to translate into Chinese.

copy.tagline: 将英日技术文章译成地道中文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把英文或日文技术内容准确译成中文。
copy.tagline_en: Translate English or Japanese tech articles into natural Chinese
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need accurate Chinese translation of English or Japanese tech content.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成专业科技翻译，把英文或日文技术文章翻译成自然流畅的中文，保留原文格式和技术术语。
howto.when: 当你要求翻译成中文、提到“翻译”或“translate to Chinese”，或粘贴英文/日文技术内容时触发。

say.text: 把这段英文技术文章翻译成中文。
say.note: Claude 会执行直译、问题识别、意译三步，输出流畅中文。

say.text: 翻译这个文件里的日文内容。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并翻译。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a professional tech translator, translating English or Japanese tech articles into natural, fluent Chinese while preserving original formatting and technical terms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Chinese translation, mention 'translate to Chinese' or '翻译', or paste English/Japanese tech content.

say_en.text: Translate this English tech article into Chinese.
Translate the content of this file from Japanese.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and translate it.
